paras: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to work directly with our CEO across our suite of trading APIs and new product initiatives. This is a hands-on IC role on a lean product team. You'll be deep in the data, close to customers, and working alongside engineers from concept through to launch.

This suits a strategic operator with a founder mentality. You take ownership, default to action, and drive things end to end without waiting for explicit instructions. When the data is incomplete, you form a thesis and validate it with prototypes, fast experiments, and tight iterations.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Own strategy and roadmap for your product area - an existing set of our trading APIs or a net-new initiative

Form your product ideas and decisions from three independent sources, not one:

• What customers tell you. Have regular check-ins with them, analyze their metrics, understand their pain points and what they're building next
What customers can’t tell you. Dig into onchain and internal data to spot gaps in our performance, shifts in the competitive landscape, and emerging opportunities
What you see yourself. You're plugged into DeFi and active in trading communities. You know firsthand what works and what doesn't
Be a true partner to our engineering leads - reason through hard problems with them, weigh the tradeoffs, and decide what's worth building
Partner with GTM on positioning and driving adoption
Work directly with the CEO and leadership to help shape product direction

sections.title: Who you are
bullets: 6+ years in product , or the equivalent as a founder, GM, or trader who moved into building
Shipped B2B, API, or infra products with real adoption and revenue
Data-driven - you build your own Dune dashboards and dig into API performance and internal analytics in Grafana, Metabase, or similar
Technically fluent - you hold your own with engineers on routing, execution quality, latency, and whatever else the problem demands
DeFi-native - onchain trading, perps, dex aggregation. You're the user you're building for
Expert AI user - you run agents, automate your workflows, and build tooling that multiplies your output
You exhibit our core values: do the right thing, consistently ship, and focus on long-term impact

paras: At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. • Lead discovery with customers, internal partners, and data to identify the highest-impact enterprise problems and workflows.

paras: We're hiring our next Senior Product Manager for the Enterprise side of Brellium. You’ll own the product our enterprise customers live in every day: every interface a customer touches, the integrations that connect us to their EMR, and the implementation process that gets them live.

Enterprise healthcare customers are demanding, their data is messy, and their timelines are real. Your job is to ensure Brellium is a product that a 5000-clinician organization can adopt in weeks instead of quarters; and to build the loop making the next customer faster than the last.

sections.title: What you'll own
paras: Customer-facing surface area. The web app, our notifications service, reporting, our API, and permissions. Everything a customer sees, uses, and administers.
EMR integrations. The connective tissue of the product. You'll decide what we build, what we buy, and how we make integrating with a new EMR go from a project to a configuration.

Implementations. Large enterprise rollouts, where you'll be close to the customer and accountable for time-to-value. And productizing our smaller implementations, turning repeated manual work into product so the team scales without headcount.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Own problems end-to-end: discovery, definition, build, launch, and the follow-through after launch.
Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering. You'll be in the technical detail on integrations, data models, and permissions — enough to make real tradeoffs instead of just relaying them.
Turn implementation work into product. Find the manual steps, the spreadsheets, and the one-off scripts, and replace them.
Partner with sales, CS, and implementation on live accounts — and bring what you learn back into the roadmap.
Sit with providers and administrators. Understand their workflow before proposing a solution.

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. sections.title: About the Role
paras: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help bring one of Clair's next products to life.

The product you'll initially work on exists today in successful private beta and is actively being expanded. That means you'll have a unique opportunity to join early in the product journey and help shape how we take an idea from concept to a real-world product and experience.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a perfectly defined roadmap or be handed a clear playbook for success. We have a direction, a problem we're working to solve, and a vision, but there is still plenty to figure out. You'll help turn ambiguity into action, make smart decisions with imperfect information, and work alongside a small, highly collaborative team to build, test, learn, and iterate quickly.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Identify, evaluate, and help define opportunities for new Clair products and experiences, often before the problem or solution is fully understood.
Define and execute product strategy and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Partner closely with engineering and design to move quickly from concept to experiment to product, balancing speed with thoughtful execution.
Build, test, learn, and iterate quickly—knowing when to invest further and when to fail fast and move on.
Balance user experience and needs with partner priorities, business requirements, and the realities of operating an embedded fintech product.
Spend time with partner management and go-to-market teams to identify new opportunities, uncover unmet needs, and develop new product concepts when necessary.
Develop a deep understanding of Clair users through feedback, behavioral data, research, and direct conversations—and push for new ways to learn when existing data isn't enough.
Work closely with data and analytics teams to develop hypotheses, evaluate product performance, and make informed decisions without becoming paralyzed by incomplete data.

sections.title: What We're Looking For
bullets: 3+ years of product management experience, ideally with experience building new products or features from the ground up.
Experience working in consumer fintech, neobanking, financial services, or another complex and regulated industry is preferred.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity; you can create clarity and momentum without needing every decision, process, or path defined for you.

Strong product instincts paired with a willingness to test those instincts quickly and learn when you're wrong. You should be able to express and extol a strong sense of how you want a product to be before it exists.
Experience balancing multiple stakeholder needs while maintaining a clear point of view about what is best for the user and product.
Deep empathy for how Americans use financial products and an interest in how financial products can meaningfully impact people's lives and financial wellbeing.
Experience partnering closely with design teams and a strong ability to articulate product preferences, user needs, and tradeoffs.
Comfort working with engineers, data teams, and technical systems—even if you're not the most technical person in the room.

sections.title: You'll Thrive in This Role If You...
paras: This is a role for a builder. The roadmap won't always be clear, the answer won't always be obvious, and the path to success won't be pre-defined. But if you're excited by the opportunity to help shape what's next for Clair, you'll have a meaningful opportunity to do just that.
bullets: Get energized when someone says, "We don't know exactly how we're going to do this yet."
Can make progress without waiting for perfect information.
Have strong opinions, loosely held.
Know that moving fast doesn't mean rushing.
Can balance what users want, what partners need, and what the business requires.
Are comfortable being wrong, as long as you learn quickly. (We call this the ‘Roomba’ mentality - hit a wall and find a new way forward)
Enjoy creating structure where there currently isn't any.

ashby:niantic-spatial:1fcf3fd5-bc31-407c.summary:
We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

sections.title: About Niantic Spatial
paras: In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: One of the fundamental problems facing the physical AI community is the sim-to-real gap in visual-spatial understanding. We're working to close it. We're applying our team's decades of experience encoding the world precisely as it is at Google Maps, Google Earth, and Niantic Labs to build the scalable real-to-sim stack for embodied AI.

This role connects product, engineering, research, and GTM, turning technical capabilities and market insight into the positioning and assets that drive understanding, adoption, and growth. The ideal candidate combines deep technical curiosity with strategic marketing judgment.

sections.title: The Role
paras: We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale Qualitate’s Workspace product: the shared research platform where teams bring together context, generate primary intelligence, and act on strategic opportunities. You’ll lead strategy, roadmap, and execution for Workspace while pursuing opportunities across the client application that help customers make stronger decisions faster.

At Qualitate, we believe teams can execute measurably better research programs when their colleagues, context, and insights come together in one shared knowledge repository. You’ll make that vision tangible: help users frame a question, bring in what their organization already knows, capture new primary data, and analyze the findings with their team. Each research program should leave behind knowledge that makes the next one more valuable.

Your mandate spans the Workspace experience and its adoption. You’ll make it seamless for users to find value, invite colleagues, contribute context, and build lasting research habits together. Success means teams repeatedly using Qualitate to conduct better research, reach decisions faster, and expand the platform’s role in their work.

sections.title: What the Day-to-Day Looks Like

Make knowledge easy to find and reuse. Partner with design and engineering on the organization, navigation, search, and sharing of research. Connect questions, sources, findings, and decisions so knowledge stays useful across people and projects.

Unlock new research through AI and shared context. Help teams identify gaps in what they know and capture new primary data and insights. Turn AI capabilities into useful, dependable workflows with clear expectations for accuracy, transparency, and user control.

Grow sustained team adoption. Connect individual value to teammate activation, recurring collaboration, retention, and expansion. Use customer research, product analytics, and experiments to identify friction and understand which experiences make teams return.

Ship with pace and care. Work closely with design, engineering, data science, research, and marketing to deliver focused improvements. Set a high bar for everyday interactions, make timely tradeoffs, and own rollout and iteration through demonstrated impact.

You’ve turned product value into sustained adoption. You have demonstrated impact on activation, recurring team usage, retention, or expansion. You understand how invitations, sharing, and collaboration can drive product-led growth and can connect those mechanics to lasting customer value.

You bring sound AI product judgment. You understand how AI can help teams capture context, synthesize evidence, and carry out work, and how its limitations shape the experience. You use AI tools hands-on to research, prototype, analyze data, or build software.

You use evidence and judgment together. You are fluent in product analytics and experimentation, curious about how customers work, and commercially grounded. You can make clear recommendations with incomplete information and update your view as you learn.

You take ownership and create momentum. You work effectively with engineers on technical constraints and tradeoffs, communicate clearly, and handle disagreement directly. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and turn ambiguous opportunities into clear priorities and focused releases.

sections.title: About WeTravel
paras: Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences.

sections.title: What's the role
paras: As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. Getting that right is often what wins the deal, and what keeps the customer for years.

In practice, you're the technical partner organizers and our commercial team rely on, from the first discovery call to a smooth go-live. You'll understand how a travel business runs, design how WeTravel fits into it, and prove it works using our public APIs, webhooks and no-code tools like Zapier.

But the role goes beyond individual customers. As more organizers connect WeTravel to their business, every integration teaches us something about what the platform should do next. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. A few areas where we'll need you:
bullets: Public API and webhooks: bring input in the roadmap of our APIs based on what customers actually try to build
Integration playbooks: turn recurring setups into reusable guides, templates and reference implementations
Pre-sales at scale: create demos, sample and solution blueprints that help our sales team answer technical questions confidently, without needing an engineer on every call

Build tailored demos and quick proofs of concept that show how WeTravel plugs into the prospect's existing tools

greenhouse:cloudflare:8393704.summary: At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Senior Majors Account Manager to join our Strategic Sales Team, responsible for a portfolio of Cloudflare’s largest and most strategic existing customers. Your primary mission is to retain, develop, and expand these relationships by deepening executive alignment, accelerating platform adoption, and identifying significant growth opportunities across customer divisions, business units, and international operations. Success requires a sophisticated blend of strategic account management, enterprise sales execution, customer advocacy, and genuine technical fluency, enabling credible engagement from the boardroom to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure.

As a Senior Majors Account Manager, you will own your customer portfolio end-to-end, acting as the single accountable leader for long-term account strategy, retention, renewals, and expansion. You will build multi-year account plans, establish trusted executive relationships, lead strategic business reviews, and orchestrate virtual teams across Customer Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, and Partners. You will connect Cloudflare’s capabilities to each customer’s most important business and technology priorities, positioning Cloudflare as an indispensable long-term platform partner. In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will actively leverage AI tools across account research, planning, executive engagement, value analysis, meeting preparation, and pipeline management—using them to improve both customer outcomes and the effectiveness of your own execution.

sections.title: Responsibilities
paras: Strategic Account Growth & Retention: Own the retention, renewal, and expansion of a defined portfolio of strategic Majors accounts. Develop and execute growth strategies across products, divisions, subsidiaries, geographies, and use cases. Identify whitespace and prioritise opportunities according to customer value, platform fit, and revenue potential. Executive Relationship Management: Build and sustain broad, multi-threaded relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level. Establish yourself as a trusted strategic advisor by bringing relevant industry insight, a clear point of view, and thoughtful recommendations. Lead executive business reviews that demonstrate value delivered, align on future priorities, and create a shared multi-year vision.

A strong record of building and executing multi-year account strategies that deliver durable customer relationships, high retention, predictable renewals, and sustained revenue growth.

Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), Connectivity, Developer Platforms, Edge Computing and Public Cloud , with the ability to engage credibly with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and senior infrastructure leaders.

sections.title: What Makes Cloudflare Special?
paras: We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

greenhouse:contentstack:8010026003.summary:
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

sections.title: What is Contentstack?
paras: Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. sections.title: Who Are We?
paras: At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

Contentstack is an AI-forward company, and we bring practical experience using AI tools and technologies to improve how we work, learn, solve problems, and drive impact.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to build a partner motion from the ground up, shape how we compete in the market, and make a measurable commercial impact, we’d love to hear from you! Here’s what you’ll be doing:

Own the agency go-to-market strategy end to end — including target partner profile, messaging, offerings, and growth plans — across a portfolio of global agencies such as Code & Theory, Omnicom, WPP, Dentsu/Merkle, Razorfish, and Monks.

Build the agency go-to-market messaging and offering, positioning Contentstack for marketing leaders and CMOs and helping agencies see where we can compete alongside — and against — enterprise suites like Adobe and Optimizely.

greenhouse:cookunity:7826633003.summary:
Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. sections.title: About CookUnity
paras: Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. Partner tightly with Design to create discovery experiences that reduce friction, build confidence, and feel intuitive across every entry point.

Collaborative and low-ego at the seam between your work and adjacent PM domains; you know how to maintain shared ownership without losing accountability.
Rigorous about experimentation and metrics without being paralyzed by them.

greenhouse:credible:8075638.summary: Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: Credible is looking for an AI-native Principal Product Manager to take ownership of our personal loans lending marketplace, our largest marketplace. You will own and deliver features from ideation to launch alongside design, engineering, and data. Primarily you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps consumers discover and compare options across multiple lenders.

This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build. In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources.You bring the experience and rigor to know which few ideas are worth building, and the drive to see them through.

In the product itself, you will shape how Credible reaches users as loan discovery moves beyond the comparison page and into AI assistants and embedded experiences, and you will determine where AI belongs within our own funnel to make comparing and choosing a loan simpler. Where AI touches the product, you own the quality bar: defining what good output looks like, measuring it, and ensuring it stays accurate and compliant.

sections.title: Responsibilities:
bullets: Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps consumers discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.

Own the Roadmap: Manage the roadmap for personal loans by identifying opportunities in the industry and within our own funnel, weighing tradeoffs, and prioritizing team resources. Decide not only what to build, but what to remove.

Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.

Make Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis rather than depending on others for every question.

Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.

Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Personal loans lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

bullets: At least 7 - 10 years of experience in a Product Management role for web-based consumer Internet products
Bachelor's Degree
Deep, demonstrated fluency using AI tools in your actual workflow for prototyping, analysis, research synthesis, and writing, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they don't
Genuine interest in and ideas about building AI-powered product experiences, not just using AI to work faster
Ability to bring working concepts to life, whether through AI tooling, light coding, or strong partnership with engineering
Familiarity with how to evaluate AI output quality, or clear aptitude and appetite to own it
Ability to use data, your experience, and product instincts to identify the most impactful areas of focus, including running your own analysis
Strong analytical abilities across spreadsheets, SQL, and other analytics tools

sections.title: Why work at Credible?

Command of product and data tools (SQL, Looker, Mixpanel, Jira, or similar)

paras: Dealpath is the world's largest and most trusted AI-powered operating system for real estate investing. Folia (‘foglia’ is leaf in Italian) was named for the power of the individual contributions of people tracking their own health experiences. sections.title: The role
paras: We're seeking an analytical, execution-oriented Product Marketing Manager to drive engagement and retention marketing for SoFi Checking and Savings, the foundation of our deposits business and our largest driver of member growth. This role focuses on our existing member base: deepening the relationships we already have, growing and retaining balances and direct deposits, and bringing dormant accounts back to life.

Your core KPIs will be deposits and direct deposits, with a specific focus on growing and retaining balances across our existing member base. You'll own the promotions and offers that ladder to those goals, working directly with the technical teams that build and implement them. You'll work alongside our Lifecycle Marketing team on engagement and retention campaigns, and partner closely with product and engineering on product-led experiments that turn accounts into everyday banking habits. This includes driving ongoing account utilization as well as reducing churn and reactivating dormant members.

Analytical rigor is central to this role. Segmentation, audience development, and offer testing are primary levers for driving deposit and direct deposit growth, and we're looking for someone with the quantitative depth to identify opportunities within the member base and the judgment to prioritize the ones worth pursuing.

sections.title: What you’ll do:
bullets: Drive day-to-day engagement and retention marketing for Checking & Savings, with core KPIs on deposits and direct deposits across our existing member base
Grow and retain balances and direct deposit relationships by identifying the highest-leverage member segments, sizing the opportunity, and building the plan to move them

Own the promotions, sweepstakes, and offers tied to your KPIs, from offer construction and setup through launch, compliance review, and post-campaign analysis, working directly with the technical teams that build and implement them
Develop sophisticated segmentation and testing programs, designing audience and offer tests that identify and unlock incremental value across the member base
Partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing to design, launch, and optimize engagement and retention campaigns across email, push, in-app, and other owned channels
Work with product and engineering on product-led experiments: in-product prompts, feature surfacing, and flows that drive direct deposit and balance growth among established members
Reduce churn and reactivate dormant members through member segmentation, targeted offers, and disciplined testing
Build the measurement plan and own the readout: define success up front, read results with an eye toward incrementality, and turn findings into concrete recommendations for the next cycle

Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect day-to-day execution to business outcomes, prioritize where it matters, and make a reasoned case for a recommendation

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven experience working closely with cross-functional teams, especially Product and technical/engineering partners. You can translate marketing needs into requirements a technical team can build against
Experimentation: Experience designing and running tests in campaigns, in product, or both and distilling results into insights others can act on
Project Management: Ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns, dependencies, and deadlines without losing the details
Communication: Write clearly and concisely; can brief a creative team and present a readout to partners with equal ease
Initiative & Bias for Action: Eagerness to roll up your sleeves to get things done (even the unglamorous things)

paras: You’ll own the strategy and execution for this initiative, starting with understanding how sellers operate, what they need from their software, and what would motivate them to switch platforms. Define and analyze metrics across adoption, engagement, and retention, using product data, seller feedback, and experimentation to guide iteration and measure impact

sections.title: Summary
paras: A commander looking at a recommended target and effect pairing asks two questions: why this, and why now? Target Effect Pairing (TEP) is a capability for USPACOM Joint Fires, built on the Maven Smart System, that answers both with AI recommendations a targeting staff can trace, explain, and audit. It speeds up capabilities analysis and the commander's decision and force assignment, while every inherently governmental decision stays with a human. Engineers can build the software. They can't tell on their own whether it reflects how joint targeting is really done.

That judgment is yours. You bring operational targeting experience and the working habits of a product manager, and you turn joint targeting doctrine, JFE and JTCB workflows, and target development standards into requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You work with a Senior UX Designer, software engineers and architects, and a Technical Program Manager who owns backlog priority and government acceptance. You own whether what gets built is operationally right.

Requirements are still forming, and much of the team has never worked in targeting. The recommendations this capability produces will also be independently assessed for quality, so output that merely looks reasonable won't hold up.
bullets: Government targeteers review your map of the current workflow, from target development through nomination, approval, and assessment, and confirm it is accurate.
Engineers and designers can say where each JFE or JTCB decision happens, and who holds the authority for it, without coming to you first.
Where the command's practice departs from doctrine, the gap is written down along with which one the product follows and why.
Engineers build from your user stories and acceptance criteria without a rework cycle over operational intent.
Every inherently governmental decision point appears in the requirements, with the human approval it needs spelled out.
Feature requests reach the backlog framed as the operational problem behind them, not only as the feature someone asked for.
The Technical Program Manager gets priority recommendations grounded in operational value, with the reasoning visible.

sections.title: Objective 3: By month six, prove that recommendations hold up before a commander sees them
bullets: Representative scenarios and acceptance criteria test whether a pairing recommendation is complete, relevant, and defensible.
Each recommendation answers why this and why now, with its assumptions and limits stated plainly enough for a targeteer to challenge.
Operational problems show up in your scenarios first, rather than in government evaluation.

sections.title: Objective 4: By the end of year one, make operator feedback what steers the product
bullets: Demonstrations with targeteers, JFE and JTCB staff, and J32 operators produce feedback that changes what gets built next.
Each capability has measures of success agreed before it is built, and you report against them after it ships.
Government stakeholders hear progress, risks, and open decisions from you before they have to ask.

smartrecruiters:servicenow:7440001507154.summary: CRM Voice AI builds autonomous voice agents for customer service that resolve customer interactions end-to-end and drive significant value for the business. We're a team inside ServiceNow's CRM business unit, shipping production voice AI with enterprise customers today and scaling aggressively. Our agents run on a real-time streaming pipeline with best-in-class orchestration, integrated into the same platform where many of our customers already manage their front, middle, and back-office workflows. For those that don't, the voice agent is often the tip of the spear that brings them in. We compete directly against well-funded AI startups and CCaaS incumbents, and we're winning.

sections.title: How We Work:
paras: We work in pods - small, dedicated teams embedded with a single enterprise customer, building their voice agents from first call to self-sufficiency. A pod owns the full lifecycle: agent shadowing, conversation design, build, production go-live, monitoring and optimization and the handoff that makes the customer self-sufficient so the pod can move on to the next one. Each pod pairs forward-deployed engineers with a product manager who owns both the customer outcome and the product learning that comes from it.

Every PM on this team runs at least one pod directly and has visibility across others. You're in the customer's world - on their calls, in their systems, solving their problems - while simultaneously shaping what the product becomes. The learnings from your pods feed directly into the platform roadmap and into repeatable, productized assets that scale beyond any single customer.

sections.title: What This Role Owns:
bullets: You run one pod directly and float across one to two others, providing product direction and unblocking teams. You own the relationship with the customer’s leadership team, setting the timelines and expectations, then delivering on them.
For those pods, you and your team of FDEs own agent design, the build and evaluation.

You also support a variety of industry verticals. As you see patterns across your pods and model evaluations, you identify which capabilities and conversation designs can be prioritized and productized for a specific industry, building the playbook for how CRM Voice AI enters a new market.

sections.title: Why This and Not Somewhere Else:
paras: The pod model means you’ll accumulate more production voice AI experience in a year than most PMs get in several - building agents across different industries, different contact center environments, and different conversation types. On top of that, speech models are the most dynamic layer of the voice AI stack right now, and most PMs evaluating them do it in a lab. You're doing it against real production traffic with enterprise customers who have real SLAs. You sit at the intersection of the platform team building the voice infrastructure and the CRM team deploying it, with influence in both directions. The right evaluation methodology is a genuine competitive advantage, and you're the person building it.

sections.title: What You Bring:
bullets: 8+ years of product management experience, with recent work in voice AI, conversational AI, or speech technology.

Hands-on experience building and evaluating AI agents - conversation design, prompt engineering, testing and iteration against real user interactions. This is the foundation; speech model expertise layers on top of it.

Working knowledge of speech models - ASR architectures, TTS synthesis approaches, and the tradeoffs between latency, accuracy, naturalness, and cost. You've evaluated or deployed these in production, not just prototyped.
Comfort with experimentation and evaluation methodology. You know how to design a test, instrument it, and turn the results into a product decision.
Experience with telephony integration: SIP, call transfers, IVR systems, or CCaaS platforms.
Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical products.
Ability to context-switch between deep technical model evaluation and customer-facing product work without dropping either.
